texty.t3: HubGet is in early development. We’re upfront about what it can already do and what is still on the way.
texty.t6: Listing installed apps, search, install, update, uninstall and installer download.
texty.t10: Search, install, update and uninstall right in the app, including an overview of available updates. If Chocolatey is missing, HubGet installs it in one click.
texty.t14: Search, install, update and uninstall without admin rights. HubGet adds a missing Scoop, Git and buckets by itself.
texty.t18: npm, Bun, pip, Cargo, vcpkg, .NET Tool, PowerShell 7 / 5 – search, install, update and uninstall in Developer mode. If Node.js, Python, Rust, the .NET SDK or PowerShell 7 is missing, HubGet installs it via WinGet.
texty.t21: Switch to “Developer” mode to manage libraries and developer tools too – search, install, update and uninstall right in HubGet. Every app comes with ready-made commands for WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop and more – copy them in one click. Export bundles as a PowerShell script.
texty.t22: npm, Bun, pip, Cargo, vcpkg, .NET Tool and PowerShell for real
texty.t23: Installs a missing Node.js, Python or Rust in one click
texty.t24: An overview of terminal commands for every manager, with explanations
